changes: Replace unbounded pipeline promise map with LRU retention bounded by both entry count and modeled source/key metadata bytes.
Default limits are 64 entries and 1 MiB modeled metadata; zero disables retention and oversized entries execute uncached.
Rejected compilation removes only its own current entry, preserving replacements after eviction or device invalidation.
Document limits and opaque GPU-driver memory boundary in package README.

coverage: Recency and 1000-entry churn under a two-entry cap.
Exact metadata capacity, one byte less, oversized entries, clearing, disabled retention and invalid configuration.
Stale rejection after replacement and current compilation failure cleanup.
Real Dawn eviction/recompilation preserves output and updates compiledResident planning cost signals.

remaining: Pipeline metadata capacity is currently separate from shared/per-query allocation pools; integration remains required.
Selection descriptors and cache ownership must be admitted before enabling allocationScopeOperators for WebGPU.
Opaque driver compiled-code bytes are not measured; bounded references do not prove a whole-runtime byte cap.
